title: Zero mean of a constant linear form applied to the derivative of a compactly supported C^1 map
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers and L := L(R^n, R^l) with the operator norm. Let c : L -> R be a continuous linear form and zeta : R^n -> R^l a C^1 map with compact support. Then the Lebesgue integral over R^n of c(Dzeta(x)) is 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (c : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ), ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ∫ x, c (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = 0
